run: Baseline run: the same 84 checks against the unmodified SimpleLife.html at 533bf9e
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/152.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/152.0.0.0

tests.title: A task stays pending before its scheduled time
A task starts alarming exactly at its scheduled time
An unanswered alarm is flagged missed once its grace window passes
Being flagged missed raises exactly one family notification
A completed task never alarms again that day
A task not scheduled for today never alarms
A snooze re-alarms after the priority snooze interval, not before
Critical tasks cannot be snoozed
Important tasks allow exactly one snooze
Flexible tasks allow exactly three snoozes
Asking for help resolves the task and notifies the family
A per-task grace override wins over the priority default
A critical task tells the family at the grace point but keeps sounding
tests.detail: a critical alarm must not give up on its own: expected "alarming", got "missed"

tests.title: The earliest triggered alarm is the one presented
Next-up skips resolved tasks and returns the soonest remaining one
A task whose time passed while the app was closed does not silently vanish
Test now schedules a rehearsal without touching the real status
A rehearsal alarm rings about three seconds later
Finishing a rehearsal clears it and leaves the real task pending
Snoozing a rehearsal keeps it quiet for the snooze interval
tests.detail: expected "delayed", got "alarming"

tests.title: An ignored rehearsal expires quietly without alerting the family
tests.detail: the rehearsal should have been dropped

tests.title: Asking for help during a rehearsal does not alarm the family
A named activity is saved with all of its settings
An unnamed activity is refused and the error is shown
Editing an activity updates it in place instead of duplicating it
A grace window of zero or less is rejected
A grace window beyond the allowed maximum is rejected
tests.detail: the form advertises a 180 minute maximum but stored 9999

tests.title: Choosing a priority loads its recommended grace window
At least one weekday always stays selected
Repeat days are stored in a stable, sorted order
tests.detail: days should be stored sorted: expected [1,3,5], got [5,1,3]

tests.title: A name containing markup is rendered as text, never as HTML
Cancelling the form discards the entry
With no document uploaded the four protected screens stay shut
The legal screen itself stays reachable while locked
Uploading a document opens up the rest of the app
Removing the last document locks up again and closes the open screen
Locked navigation buttons are marked as unavailable to assistive tech
tests.detail: a locked button must expose its state, not only a grey colour

tests.title: The app has a working storage backend
tests.detail: there is nowhere to save the schedule

tests.title: Saving the schedule does not raise an error
tests.detail: saveState reported: Could not save TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'set')

tests.title: A saved schedule can be read back
tests.detail: storageBackend is not defined

tests.title: Midnight and noon are labelled correctly
A task on all seven days reads as "Every day"
File sizes are shown in sensible units
Ordinal dates are spelled correctly, including the teens
Every HTML-significant character is escaped
The badge counts only unread items from today
With nothing unread the badge is hidden
"Mark all as read" clears today without rewriting history
tests.detail: an older day was silently marked read from the today screen: expected false, got true

tests.title: Help requests and misses are worded differently
Upcoming lists only unresolved tasks for today
Upcoming shows a friendly note when the day is clear
Existing lists every task with its days and priority
Existing does not show an off-day task as if it were still to come
The task list is ordered by time of day
A missed task is shown with the alert icon, not the done icon
The date pill shows today on every screen
Rendering a screen does not quietly rewrite stored history
tests.detail: drawing the screen created status entries as a side effect: expected "{}", got "{\"2026-09-10|act-wglcja\":{\"status\":\"pending\"}}"

tests.title: The screen stays calm and empty when nothing is due
A due task takes over the screen with its name
A critical alarm offers no snooze button
A flexible alarm offers a snooze button
Finishing from the alarm marks the task done and confirms it
The confirmation clears itself and returns to the calm screen
The alarm never appears on the family device
The alarm shows the picture chosen for the task
A task with no picture leaves no broken image behind
A critical alarm keeps sounding until it is confirmed, as promised
tests.detail: the promise shown to the family is "The alarm keeps sounding until it's confirmed done", but the alarm went silent after 10 minutes

tests.title: The snooze button survives long enough to be pressed
tests.detail: the button is torn down and rebuilt on every tick, so it loses keyboard focus once a second

tests.title: A task whose time passed hours ago is not rung as if it were due now
tests.detail: lunch was rung at 20:00 with a fresh 20 minute grace window instead of being reported missed: expected "missed", got "alarming"

tests.title: The family is told about a miss on the day it happened, not hours later
tests.detail: no notification was raised when the app opened after the slot

tests.title: The confirmation tick is not shown when nothing was just finished
tests.detail: a negative elapsed time counts as "just finished" and shows a stray tick: expected false, got true

tests.title: The page can be pinch-zoomed
tests.detail: zoom is blocked by the viewport tag: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1

tests.title: The repeat-day picker can be operated from a keyboard
tests.detail: the day chips are plain divs, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot set repeats

tests.title: The repeat-day picker reports its on/off state
tests.detail: selected days are conveyed by colour alone

tests.title: Each weekday chip has a distinguishable label
tests.detail: the chips read as S,M,T,W,T,F,S - Sat/Sun and Tue/Thu are ambiguous: expected 7, got 5

tests.title: Modal dialogs announce themselves as dialogs
tests.detail: the add/edit sheet is not exposed as a dialog

tests.title: Toast messages are announced to screen readers
tests.detail: toasts are the only feedback for a refused action, and they are silent to screen readers

tests.title: The alarm screen is announced when it takes over
tests.detail: the alarm takeover is invisible to assistive technology

tests.title: Old day records are not kept for ever
tests.detail: pruneHistory is not defined

tests.title: Pruning keeps recent days and only drops genuinely old ones
tests.detail: pruneHistory is not defined

tests.title: The notification history is capped
tests.detail: kept 300 notifications

tests.title: Deleting a task also clears its pending rehearsal
tests.detail: a rehearsal was left behind for a task that no longer exists

tests.title: Cancelling a delete keeps the task
A rehearsal for a deleted task cannot ring
